EXECUTION

Use the Secret Primary Blue to create drenched hues and focus on harsh lighting, shadows to accentuate the surface material of the products.

Create translucence and refractive index to add depth to the shots using elements such as water, ice, mist reflective surfaces, glass, etc.

Use of props, hand models for application shots, lifestyle shots can be used contextually (example: bathroom set up for Body wash product spotlight)
